Augurium Task Force.target: One Grey Knights Walker unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Augurium Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Augurium Task Force.name: MIRAGE OF ECHOES
Augurium Task Force.when: The Reinforcements step of your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is set up.
Augurium Task Force.target: One Grey Knights Psyker unit from your army that is within 12" of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Augurium Task Force.effect: If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.

Augurium Task Force.name: NECESSARY END
Augurium Task Force.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Augurium Task Force.target: One Grey Knights Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Augurium Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. If the result is greater than the current battle round number, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Augurium Task Force.name: REDIRECTED STRIKE
Augurium Task Force.target: One Grey Knights Psyker unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Augurium Task Force.effect: If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves. Designer’s Note: This Stratagem lets players utilise abilities that retain control of objective markers and react to their missions and objectives with this unit.

Baneslayer Strike.name: ARMOURED AEGIS
Baneslayer Strike.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Baneslayer Strike.target: One GREY KNIGHTS CHARAcTER model from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Baneslayer Strike.effect: Until the end of the phase, your model has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

Baneslayer Strike.name: PSYBOLT AMMUNITION
Baneslayer Strike.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Baneslayer Strike.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of storm bolters equipped by models in your unit by 1.

Baneslayer Strike.name: RELENTLESS BOARDERS
Baneslayer Strike.target: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to charge this phase.
Baneslayer Strike.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Baneslayer Strike.name: SANCTIC CIRCLE
Baneslayer Strike.target: One GREY KNIGHTS CHARAcTER or PALADIN SqUAD unit from your army.
Baneslayer Strike.effect: Select one objective marker within 9” of and visible to your unit. If that objective marker does not have any enemy models within range of it (excluding Battle-shocked models), your unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 1 from the result if that objective marker is Secured by your opponent’s army. If that test is passed, that objective marker is no longer considered Secured by your opponent’s army and is Secured by your army.

Banishers.name: CELERITY
Banishers.target: One Grey Knights Psyker Infantry unit from your army.
Banishers.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Banishers.name: CHAOS BANE
Banishers.target: One Grey Knights Psyker unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Banishers.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI-CHAOS 4+] ability.

Banishers.name: CIRCLE OF SANCTUARY
Banishers.when: Start of your opponent’s Movement phase.
Banishers.target: One Grey Knights Character model from your army.
Banishers.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units that are set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" horizontally of your model.

Banishers.name: HEXWROUGHT REPRISAL
Banishers.target: One Grey Knights Psyker unit from your army that is on the battlefield and suffered one or more mortal wounds this phase.
Banishers.effect: Select one enemy unit which inflicted one or more mortal wounds on your unit this phase, then roll a number of dice equal to the number of mortal wounds your unit suffered this phase: for each 2+, that enemy unit suffers one mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds). These mortal wounds are Psychic Attacks.

Banishers.name: SHADOW OF ANARCH
Banishers.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Banishers.target: One Grey Knights Psyker unit from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Banishers.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6" or, if it has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.

Banishers.name: WARDING CHANT

Needgaârd Oathband.name: VOID HARDENED
Needgaârd Oathband.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets, if units from your army have Fortify Takeover.
Needgaârd Oathband.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Needgaârd Oathband.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Persecution Prospect.name: ADAPTABLE AVARICE
Persecution Prospect.when: Start of any phase, if units from your army have Fortify Takeover.
Persecution Prospect.target: One Leagues of Votann Character unit from your army.
Persecution Prospect.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend any number of YP. Once you have done so, if you have 6 or fewer YP, until the start of your next turn, units from your army have Hostile Acquisition instead.

Persecution Prospect.name: CLAIMSTAKER REFLEX
Persecution Prospect.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Persecution Prospect.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army (excluding Artillery and Vehicle units) that is within 9" of that enemy unit.
Persecution Prospect.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 2YP. Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6". If you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem, your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6" instead.
Persecution Prospect.restrictions: A unit cannot embark within a Transport as part of this move.

Persecution Prospect.name: DISPERSED FORMATION
Persecution Prospect.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Persecution Prospect.target: One Leagues of Votann Infantry or Leagues of Votann Mounted unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Persecution Prospect.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability and each time a ranged attack targets your unit, models in your unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

Persecution Prospect.name: EXPOSED FLAWS
Persecution Prospect.target: One Hernkyn unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Persecution Prospect.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can spend 2YP. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if you spent YP during this use of this Stratagem and/or if that attack targets an assailed unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

Persecution Prospect.name: FRONTIER MOMENTUM
Persecution Prospect.target: One Hernkyn unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Persecution Prospect.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

Persecution Prospect.name: RANGER TACTICS
Persecution Prospect.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Persecution Prospect.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if that attack targets an assailed unit and/or if your unit has the Hernkyn keyword, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

Void Salvagers.name: CORRIDOR COVERED
Void Salvagers.when: Your opponent's Movement or Charge phase.
Void Salvagers.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not fired Overwatch this phase.
Void Salvagers.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6.

Void Salvagers.name: JUDGED AND PUNISHED
Void Salvagers.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Void Salvagers.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the target has 1 or more Judgement tokens, you can re-roll the Hit roll, and if the target has 2 Judgement tokens, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.

Void Salvagers.name: POINT-BLANK FIRE
Void Salvagers.target: One HEARTHKYN WARRIORS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Void Salvagers.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] ability.

Void Salvagers.name: RELIC CYPHER
Void Salvagers.effect: Select one closed Hatchway on the battlefield and open it.
Void Salvagers.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once.

Annihilation Legion.name: BLOOD-FUELLED CRUELTY
Annihilation Legion.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.
Annihilation Legion.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that started the phase within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
Annihilation Legion.effect: Roll one D6: on a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds. Your unit can then make a Normal move, but must end that move as close as possible to that enemy unit.

Annihilation Legion.name: INSANITY’S IRE
Annihilation Legion.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Annihilation Legion.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed by the attacking unit’s attacks.
Annihilation Legion.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move, but must end that move as close as possible to that enemy unit.

Annihilation Legion.name: MASKS OF DEATH
Annihilation Legion.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Annihilation Legion.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Annihilation Legion.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Annihilation Legion.name: MURDEROUS REANIMATION
Annihilation Legion.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that has just destroyed an enemy unit, or just caused an enemy unit that was not Below Half-strength to become Below Half-strength.

Annihilation Legion.name: PITILESS HUNTERS
Annihilation Legion.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Annihilation Legion.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".

Annihilation Legion.name: THE SPOOR OF FRAILTY
Annihilation Legion.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Annihilation Legion.target: One DESTROYER CULT or FLAYED ONES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Annihilation Legion.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model from your unit makes an attack that targets a unit below Starting Strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. If the target is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

Awakened Dynasty.name: PROTOCOL OF THE CONQUERING TYRANT
Awakened Dynasty.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Awakened Dynasty.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within half range, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading your unit, until the end of the phase, you can re-roll the Hit roll for that attack instead.

Awakened Dynasty.name: PROTOCOL OF THE ETERNAL REVENANT
Awakened Dynasty.target: One Necrons Infantry Character model from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
Awakened Dynasty.effect: At the end of the phase, set your model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with half of its starting number of wounds remaining.
Awakened Dynasty.restrictions: Each model can only be targeted with this Stratagem once per battle.

Awakened Dynasty.name: PROTOCOL OF THE HUNGRY VOID
Awakened Dynasty.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Awakened Dynasty.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit. In addition, If a Necrons Character is leading your unit, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1. (this is not cumulative with any other modifiers that improve Armour Penetration].

Awakened Dynasty.name: PROTOCOL OF THE SUDDEN STORM
Awakened Dynasty.effect: Until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability. In addition, if a Necrons Character is leading your unit, until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for your unit.

Awakened Dynasty.name: PROTOCOL OF THE UNDYING LEGIONS
Awakened Dynasty.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.
Awakened Dynasty.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Awakened Dynasty.effect: Your unit activates its Reanimation Protocols and reanimates D3 wounds (or D3+1 wounds if a NECRONS CHARACTER is leading your unit].

Awakened Dynasty.name: PROTOCOL OF THE VENGEFUL STARS
Awakened Dynasty.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a NECRONS unit from your army.
Awakened Dynasty.target: One NECRONS CHARACTER unit from your army that was within 6" of that NECRONS unit when it was destroyed.
Awakened Dynasty.effect: After the attacking unit has resolved its attacks, your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but it must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

Canoptek Court.name: COUNTERTEMPORAL SHIFT
Canoptek Court.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Canoptek Court.target: One CANOPTEK unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Canoptek Court.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

Canoptek Court.name: CURSE OF THE CRYPTEK
Canoptek Court.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
Canoptek Court.target:
One CRYPTEK model from your army that was destroyed by one of the attacking unit’s attacks. 
You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
Canoptek Court.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly CANOPTEK model makes an attack that targets the attacking unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

Canoptek Court.name: CYNOSURE OF ERADICATION
Canoptek Court.when: The start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
Canoptek Court.target: One CRYPTEK or CANOPTEK unit from your army that is wholly within your army’s Power Matrix.
Canoptek Court.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by CRYPTEK or CANOPTEK models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

Canoptek Court.name: REACTIVE SUBROUTINES
Canoptek Court.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Canoptek Court.target: One CANOPTEK unit from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit.
Canoptek Court.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

Canoptek Court.name: SOLAR PULSE
Canoptek Court.target: One CRYPTEK model from your army.
Canoptek Court.effect: Select one objective marker within 18" of your CRYPTEK model. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by friendly NECRONS models have the [IGNORES COVER] ability while targeting units within range of that objective marker.

Canoptek Court.name: SUBOPTIMAL FACADE
Canoptek Court.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.
Canoptek Court.target: One CANOPTEK unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge and is wholly within your army’s Power Matrix.

Canoptek Harvesters.name: NANOSCARAB VIRUS
Canoptek Harvesters.target: One CRYPTEK unit from your army.
Canoptek Harvesters.effect: For each open Hatchway within 3" of your unit, you can close that Hatchway.
Canoptek Harvesters.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once.

Canoptek Harvesters.name: PHASE-SHIFT
Canoptek Harvesters.target: One CANOPTEK WRAITHS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Canoptek Harvesters.effect: The next time your unit is selected to move this phase, models in that unit can move through Walls and closed Hatchways as if they were not there, but when doing so, no model can move more than 6".
Canoptek Harvesters.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once.

Canoptek Harvesters.name: QUANTUM FLARE-SHIELD
Canoptek Harvesters.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Canoptek Harvesters.target: One CRYPTEK model from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Canoptek Harvesters.effect: Until the end of the phase, your model has a 4+ invulnerable save.

Canoptek Harvesters.name: TARGETING ALGORITHMS
Canoptek Harvesters.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Canoptek Harvesters.target: One CRYPTEK model from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Canoptek Harvesters.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your model makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

Cryptek Conclave.name: ANIMUS CURSE
Cryptek Conclave.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
Cryptek Conclave.target: One Cryptek model from your army that was destroyed by one of the attacking unit’s attacks. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
Cryptek Conclave.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly NECRONS model makes an attack that targets the attacking unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

Cryptek Conclave.name: MICROSCARAB SWARM
Cryptek Conclave.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Cryptek Conclave.target: One Cryptek Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Cryptek Conclave.effect: If your unit has the Necron Warriors keyword, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save. If your unit has the Immortals keyword, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

Cryptek Conclave.name: MOLECULAR TARGETING
Cryptek Conclave.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Cryptek Conclave.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Cryptek Conclave.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: that attack’s Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill characteristic; the Hit roll. If your unit has the Cryptek keyword, you can also ignore any or all modifiers to the Wound roll.

Cryptek Conclave.name: POTENTIALITY SYPHON
Cryptek Conclave.target: One NECRONS unit from your army within range of one or more objective markers.
Cryptek Conclave.effect: Your unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate. If it is a Cryptek unit, it reanimates an additional 1 wound.

Cryptek Conclave.name: SYNERGISTIC EMPOWERMENT
Cryptek Conclave.target: One Cryptek unit from your army.
Cryptek Conclave.effect: Select one friendly NECRONS model (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) within 12" of a CRYPTEK model in your unit. Until the end of the phase, that friendly NECRONS model has the CRYPTEK keyword.

Cryptek Conclave.name: UNTAPPED POWER
Cryptek Conclave.target: One Cryptek unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Cryptek Conclave.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to shoot, when selecting an ability for the Technosorcerous Augmentations Detachment Rule, you can select one additional ability from those available.

Cursed Legion.name: DRIVEN TO BUTCHERY
Cursed Legion.when: Your Shooting phase or your Charge phase.
Cursed Legion.target: One Destroyer Cult unit from your army.
Cursed Legion.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
Cursed Legion.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.

Cursed Legion.name: IMAGE OF DEATH
Cursed Legion.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Cursed Legion.target: One Destroyer Cult unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Cursed Legion.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Cursed Legion.name: METHODICAL MURDER
Cursed Legion.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Cursed Legion.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Cursed Legion.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

Cursed Legion.name: MORTIS PROTOCOLS
Cursed Legion.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after the first time a Destroyer Cult unit from your army destroys an enemy unit this turn.
Cursed Legion.target: One friendly NECRONS unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) within 9" of that DESTROYER CULT unit.
Cursed Legion.effect: The friendly unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate.

Cursed Legion.name: SPREADING MADNESS
Cursed Legion.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
Cursed Legion.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit declares a charge, if one or more targets of that charge are within Engagement Range of one or more friendly units, add 2 to the Charge roll.

Cursed Legion.name: UNNATURAL AGGRESSION
Cursed Legion.when: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.
Cursed Legion.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) from your army that is within 6" of one or more enemy units and would be eligible to declare a charge against one or more of those enemy units if it were your Charge phase.
Cursed Legion.effect: Your unit now declares a charge that only targets one or more of those enemy units, and you resolve that charge. Note that even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.

Deranged Outcasts.name: BATHED IN BLOOD
Deranged Outcasts.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit is destroyed by a DESTROYER CULT unit from your army
Deranged Outcasts.effect: Select one objective marker that your unit or the destroyed unit was within range of at the start of the phase. That objective marker is Secured by your army.

Deranged Outcasts.name: RUSH TO SLAUGHTER
Deranged Outcasts.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Deranged Outcasts.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit has the FLAYED ONES keyword, each time it moves, models in that unit can move through friendly DESTROYER CULT models as if they were not there. If your unit has the DESTROYER CULT keyword, models in it can move through friendly FLAYED ONES models as if they were not there.

Deranged Outcasts.name: SHADOW STALKERS
Deranged Outcasts.when: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step.
Deranged Outcasts.target: One FLAYED ONES unit from your army that is in Reserves.
Deranged Outcasts.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Deep Strike ability.
Deranged Outcasts.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once.

Deranged Outcasts.name: TERRIFYING AMBUSH
Deranged Outcasts.when: Your Movement phase, just after a DESTROYER CULT unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
Deranged Outcasts.effect: For each enemy unit within 3" of that Hatchway, if that Hatchway is visible to that unit and that unit is wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit, that unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 2 from the result: if failed, until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot fire Overwatch.

Harbinger Cabal.name: ANTI-PROXIMAL SUBROUTINES
Harbinger Cabal.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Harbinger Cabal.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] ability.

Harbinger Cabal.name: CONTINUUM REALIGNMENT
Harbinger Cabal.target: One Cryptek unit from your army.
Harbinger Cabal.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3".

Harbinger Cabal.name: DYNAMIC RECONFIGURATION
Harbinger Cabal.target: One Cryptek unit from your army.
Harbinger Cabal.effect: Select one of the abilities from the Arcanoscientific Expertise Detachment rule. Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has that ability instead of any others from the Detachment Rule.

Harbinger Cabal.name: HOLOGYRIC SIMULATION
Harbinger Cabal.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Harbinger Cabal.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Harbinger Cabal.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if your unit is within 6" of a friendly Cryptek unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll. If your unit has the CRYPTEK keyword, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.

Hypercrypt Legion.name: COSMIC PRECISION
Hypercrypt Legion.target: One NECRONS unit from your army (excluding Monster units) that is arriving using the Deep Strike or Hyperphasing abilities this phase.
Hypercrypt Legion.effect: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models.
Hypercrypt Legion.restrictions: A unit targeted with this Stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.

Hypercrypt Legion.name: DIMENSIONAL CORRIDOR
Hypercrypt Legion.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that was set up on the battlefield this turn using the Eternity Gate ability of a MONOLITH model that started the turn on the battlefield.
Hypercrypt Legion.effect: Your unit is eligible to charge this phase.

Hypercrypt Legion.name: ENTROPIC DAMPING
Hypercrypt Legion.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Hypercrypt Legion.target: One TITANIC model from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks and is within 18" of the attacking unit.
Hypercrypt Legion.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in the attacking unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.

Hypercrypt Legion.name: HYPERPHASIC RECALL
Hypercrypt Legion.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has shot or fought.
Hypercrypt Legion.target: One NECRONS INFANTRY unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit’s attacks and one friendly MONOLITH model.
Hypercrypt Legion.effect: Remove your INFANTRY unit from the battlefield and then set it back up anywhere on the battlefield that is wholly within 6" of your MONOLITH model and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

Hypercrypt Legion.name: QUANTUM DEFLECTION
Hypercrypt Legion.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Hypercrypt Legion.target: One NECRONS VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Hypercrypt Legion.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

Hypercrypt Legion.name: REANIMATION CRYPTS
Hypercrypt Legion.effect: For each of your NECRONS units in Reserves, that Reserves unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate.

Obeisance Phalanx.name: ENSLAVED ARTIFICE
Obeisance Phalanx.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Obeisance Phalanx.target: One NECRONS unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Obeisance Phalanx.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

Obeisance Phalanx.name: NANOASSEMBLY PROTOCOLS
Obeisance Phalanx.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Obeisance Phalanx.target: One NECRONS VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Obeisance Phalanx.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

Obeisance Phalanx.name: SENTINELS OF ETERNITY
Obeisance Phalanx.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Obeisance Phalanx.target: One LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH PRAETORIANS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Obeisance Phalanx.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making attacks, and is then removed from play.

Obeisance Phalanx.name: SUFFER NO RIVAL
Obeisance Phalanx.target: One LYCHGUARD or TRIARCH unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Obeisance Phalanx.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.

Obeisance Phalanx.name: TERRITORIAL OBSESSION
Obeisance Phalanx.target: One Lychguard or Triarch unit from your army.
Obeisance Phalanx.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit. If your unit has the VEHICLE keyword, add 3 to the Objective Control characteristic instead.

Obeisance Phalanx.name: YOUR TIME IS NIGH
Obeisance Phalanx.when: Any phase, just after your opponent’s WARLORD is destroyed.
Obeisance Phalanx.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time an enemy unit takes a Battle-shock or Leadership test, subtract 1 from the result.

Pantheon of Woe.name: CHRONODISTORTION
Pantheon of Woe.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Pantheon of Woe.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Pantheon of Woe.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 if the attacking unit is unravelling: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Pantheon of Woe.name: DISHARMONISATION CASCADE
Pantheon of Woe.when: Any phase, just after a Necrons Monster model from your army is destroyed, before making its Deadly Demise roll.
Pantheon of Woe.target: That NECRONS MONSTER model. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
Pantheon of Woe.effect: Until the end of the phase, your model’s Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 3+ instead of on a 6.

Pantheon of Woe.name: ENTROPHASIC AURA TARGETING
Pantheon of Woe.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Pantheon of Woe.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding Monsters) from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Pantheon of Woe.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the target of that attack is unravelling, re-roll a Wound roll of 1 as well.

Pantheon of Woe.name: MASS TRANSMOGRIFICATION
Pantheon of Woe.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a Necrons Monster unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
Pantheon of Woe.target: One friendly NECRONS unit (excluding Monsters) within 6" of that MONSTER unit.
Pantheon of Woe.effect: If that enemy unit was unravelling at the start of the phase, your friendly unit’s Reanimation Protocols activate.
Pantheon of Woe.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.

Pantheon of Woe.name: MOLECULAR EROSION
Pantheon of Woe.target: One Necrons Monster unit from your army.
Pantheon of Woe.effect: Select one unravelling enemy unit visible to your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. When doing so, subtract 1 from the result. If that test is failed, that enemy unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.
Pantheon of Woe.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.

Pantheon of Woe.name: PHASE MELDING
Pantheon of Woe.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an unravelling enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.
Pantheon of Woe.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
Pantheon of Woe.effect: When that enemy unit Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those tests.

Starshatter Arsenal.name: CHRONOSHIFT
Starshatter Arsenal.target: One Necrons Vehicle or Necrons Mounted unit (excluding Titanic units) from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Starshatter Arsenal.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

Starshatter Arsenal.name: DIMENSIONAL TUNNEL
Starshatter Arsenal.target: One Necrons Vehicle or Necrons Mounted unit (excluding Titanic units) from your army.
Starshatter Arsenal.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit can move horizontally through models and terrain features.

Starshatter Arsenal.name: ENDLESS SERVITUDE
Starshatter Arsenal.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding Monster and Titanic units) from your army that is within range of one or more objective markers you control.

Starshatter Arsenal.name: MERCILESS RECLAMATION
Starshatter Arsenal.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Starshatter Arsenal.target: One NECRONS unit (excluding Monster and Titanic units) from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Starshatter Arsenal.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the target of that attack is within range of one or more objective markers, add 1 to the Wound roll.

Starshatter Arsenal.name: REACTIVE REPOSITION
Starshatter Arsenal.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Starshatter Arsenal.target: One NECRONS unit from your army (excluding Monster and Titanic units) that was the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Starshatter Arsenal.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

Starshatter Arsenal.name: UNYIELDING FORMS
Starshatter Arsenal.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Starshatter Arsenal.target: One Necrons Vehicle or Necrons Mounted unit (excluding Titanic units) from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Starshatter Arsenal.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets a model in your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Tomb Ship Complement.name: CONCENTRATED ATOMISATION
Tomb Ship Complement.target: One NEcRON WARRIORS or IMMORTALS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Tomb Ship Complement.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

Tomb Ship Complement.name: DISINTEGRATION BEAMS
Tomb Ship Complement.when: Your Movement phase, just after an enemy unit attempts to prevent a NECRONS unit from you army from operating a closed Hatchway.
Tomb Ship Complement.effect: Roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds.

Tomb Ship Complement.name: DISRUPTION FIELDS
Tomb Ship Complement.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.

Tomb Ship Complement.name: UNWAVERING DEFENCE
Tomb Ship Complement.target: One NECRONS unit from your army that is Set to Defend and has not fought this phase.
Tomb Ship Complement.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability.

Blitz Brigade.name: ARMOURED DUELLISTS
Blitz Brigade.target: One Orks Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Blitz Brigade.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

Blitz Brigade.name: IMPERVIOUS
Blitz Brigade.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Blitz Brigade.target: One Battlewagon, Kill Rig or Hunta Rig unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Blitz Brigade.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Blitz Brigade.name: MEKANISED BRUTALITY
Blitz Brigade.target: One Battlewagon, Kill Rig or Hunta Rig unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Blitz Brigade.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time a unit disembarks from your unit after your unit makes a Normal move, that disembarked unit is still eligible to declare a charge this turn.

Blitz Brigade.name: MOUNT UP, LADZ
Blitz Brigade.target: One Orks Infantry unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, and one friendly Transport it is able to embark within.
Blitz Brigade.effect: If your ORKS INFANTRY unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.

Blitz Brigade.name: RUN ’EM DOWN
Blitz Brigade.target: One Battlewagon, Kill Rig or Hunta Rig unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Blitz Brigade.effect: Select up to two other friendly Orks Vehicle or Orks Monster units within 6" of your unit. Until the end of the turn, your unit and each unit you selected are eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced.

Blitz Brigade.name: YOOZ IN TROUBLE NOW
Blitz Brigade.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Blitz Brigade.target: One Battlewagon, Hunta Rig or Kill Rig model from your army that was hit by one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Blitz Brigade.effect: One Orks Infantry unit embarked within your model can disembark and make a Surge move. To do so, roll one D6: models in that unit move a number of inches up to this result, but that unit must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT). When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

Bully Boyz.name: ALWAYS LOOKIN’ FER A FIGHT
Bully Boyz.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit is destroyed.
Bully Boyz.target: One Nobz or Meganobz unit from your army that destroyed that enemy unit.
Bully Boyz.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Consolidation move, it can move up to D3+3" instead of up to 3". If a Waaagh! is active for your unit, it can move up to 6" instead.

Bully Boyz.name: ARMED TO DATEEF
Bully Boyz.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Bully Boyz.target: One Nobz or Meganobz unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Bully Boyz.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If a Waaagh! is active for your unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

Bully Boyz.name: CRUSHING IMPACT
Bully Boyz.when: Your Charge phase, just after a Nobz or Meganobz unit from your army ends a Charge move.
Bully Boyz.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds). If a Waaagh! is active for your unit, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound for each 4+ instead.

Bully Boyz.name: CUT’EM DOWN
Bully Boyz.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.
Bully Boyz.target: One Nobz or Meganobz unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
Bully Boyz.effect: When that enemy unit Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if a Waaagh! is active for your unit, subtract 1 from each of those tests.

Bully Boyz.name: HULKING BRUTES
Bully Boyz.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Bully Boyz.target: One Nobz or Meganobz unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Bully Boyz.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Bully Boyz.name: TOO ARROGANT TO DIE
Bully Boyz.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Bully Boyz.target: One Nobz or Meganobz unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Bully Boyz.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not shot or fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if a Waaagh! is active for your unit. On a 5+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can shoot or fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Da Big Hunt.name: DAT ONE’S EVEN BIGGA!
Da Big Hunt.target: One Beast Snagga unit from your army.
Da Big Hunt.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back. In addition, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for your unit, provided one of the targets of that charge is your Prey.

Da Big Hunt.name: DRAG IT DOWN
Da Big Hunt.target: One Beast Snagga unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Da Big Hunt.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. In addition, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack that targets your Prey, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.

Da Big Hunt.name: INSTINCTIVE HUNTERS
Da Big Hunt.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Da Big Hunt.target: One Beast Snagga unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy unit.
Da Big Hunt.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Da Big Hunt.name: STALKIN’ TAKTIKS
Da Big Hunt.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Da Big Hunt.target: One Beast Snagga Infantry or Beast Snagga Mounted unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Da Big Hunt.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a ranged attack targets your unit, models in your unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack. In addition, if your unit has the INFANTRY keyword, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Stealth ability.

Da Big Hunt.name: UNSTOPPABLE MOMENTUM
Da Big Hunt.when: Your Charge phase, just after a Beast Snagga Mounted unit from your army ends a Charge move.
Da Big Hunt.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit and roll one D6 for each model in your unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds). If that enemy unit is your Prey, roll three additional D6.

Da Big Hunt.name: WHERE D’YA FINK YOU’RE GOING?
Da Big Hunt.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Fall Back move.
Da Big Hunt.target: One Beast Snagga Infantry or Beast Snagga Mounted unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase.
Da Big Hunt.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6".

Dread Mob.name: BIGGER SHELLS FOR BIGGER GITZ
Dread Mob.target: One Mek, Orks Walker or Grots Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Dread Mob.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can choose to push it. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE, add 1 to the Wound roll. If you chose to push it, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack and, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability as well.

Dread Mob.name: CONNIVING RUNTS
Dread Mob.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Dread Mob.target: One Gretchin unit from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units.
Dread Mob.effect: Roll one D6: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds. Your unit can then make a Normal move.

Dread Mob.name: DAKKA! DAKKA! DAKKA!
Dread Mob.target: One Orks Walker or Grots Vehicle unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Dread Mob.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can choose to push it. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If you chose to push it, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead and, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability as well.

Dread Mob.name: EXTRA GUBBINZ
Dread Mob.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Dread Mob.target: One Orks Walker or Grots Vehicle unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Dread Mob.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

Dread Mob.name: KLANKIN’ KLAWS
Dread Mob.target: One Orks Walker unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Dread Mob.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can choose to push it. Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit and, if you chose to push it, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of those weapons and they have the [HAZARDOUS] ability as well.

Dread Mob.name: SUPERFUELLED BOILER
Dread Mob.when: Your Movement phase, just after an Orks Walker unit from your army has been selected to Advance.
Dread Mob.effect: Until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for your unit and ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

Freebooter Krew.name: BASH AND GRAB
Freebooter Krew.target: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Freebooter Krew.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of the loot objective, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

Freebooter Krew.name: BOARDIN’ RUSH
Freebooter Krew.target: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Freebooter Krew.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

Freebooter Krew.name: DECK FRAGGERS
Freebooter Krew.target: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Freebooter Krew.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit targets an INFANTRY unit with a ranged weapon, that weapon has the [BLAST] ability.

Freebooter Krew.name: GRAB AND BASH
Freebooter Krew.target: One ORKS unit from your army (excluding Gretchin units) that is within range of the loot objective.
Freebooter Krew.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, the Waaagh! is active for your unit, even if you have already called a Waaagh! this battle. Designer’s Note: This means that any abilities that are in effect while the Waaagh! is active for your army will be in effect for your unit.

Freebooter Krew.name: KRUMP AND RUN
Freebooter Krew.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit falls back.
Freebooter Krew.target: One ORKS unit from your army that was within engagement range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase and is not within range of one or more enemy units.
Freebooter Krew.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

Freebooter Krew.name: ROLLING LOOT-HEAP
Freebooter Krew.target: One Flash Gitz unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Freebooter Krew.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI-VEHICLE 4+] ability.

Green Tide.name: BRAGGIN’ RIGHTS
Green Tide.target: Two Boyz units from your army that are within 6" of each other.
Green Tide.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, while those two units are within 6" of each other, they both count as containing 10 or more models for the purposes of your Detachment rule, any Enhancements models from your army have and any Stratagems you use.

Green Tide.name: BULLDOZER BRUTALITY
Green Tide.target: One Boyz unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase and is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Green Tide.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to fight, when determining which models in your unit are eligible to fight, any models in your unit that are within 3" of one or more enemy models are eligible to fight. When resolving those attacks, such models can target one of those enemy units that is within 3" of them and within Engagement Range of their unit.

Green Tide.name: COME ON LADZ!
Green Tide.target: One Boyz unit from your army.
Green Tide.effect: Return up to D3+2 destroyed models to your unit (excluding Character models).

Green Tide.name: COMPETITIVE STREAK
Green Tide.target: One Boyz unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Green Tide.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If your unit contains 10 or more models, re-roll the Wound roll instead.

Green Tide.name: GO GET ’EM!
Green Tide.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Green Tide.target: One Boyz unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Green Tide.effect: After the attacking unit has shot, your unit can make a Go Get ’Em! move. To do so, roll one D6: each model in your unit can move a distance in inches up to the result, but your unit must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit. When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit. If your unit contains 10 or more models, you can re-roll the D6 to determine how far your unit can move.

Green Tide.name: TIDE OF MUSCLE
Green Tide.target: One Boyz unit from your army that has not declared a charge this phase.
Green Tide.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit declares a charge, add 1 to the Charge roll and, if your unit contains 10 or more models, you can re-roll the Charge roll.’

Kaptin Killers.name: CORNERED AND KRUMPED
Kaptin Killers.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.
Kaptin Killers.target: One ORKS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
Kaptin Killers.effect: Your unit can fight as if it were the Fight phase, but when doing so, models in your unit can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target) and each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 is required to score a hit.

Kaptin Killers.name: LOOT ON THE MOVE
Kaptin Killers.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
Kaptin Killers.effect: Until the end of the battle, that Hatchway cannot be closed. Until the end of the turn, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Kaptin Killers.name: PILE THROUGH
Kaptin Killers.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
Kaptin Killers.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit has the Fights First ability.

Kaptin Killers.name: PIT FIGHTER
Kaptin Killers.target: One WARBOSS model from your army.
Kaptin Killers.effect: Until the end of the phase, your model is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Kult of Speed.name: BLITZA FIRE
Kult of Speed.target: One Speed Freeks unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Kult of Speed.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability and, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit within 9", a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+, instead of only a 6.
Kult of Speed.restrictions: A unit cannot be targeted by this and the Dakkastorm Stratagem in the same phase.

Kult of Speed.name: DAKKASTORM
Kult of Speed.target: One Speed Freeks unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Kult of Speed.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. While targeting a unit within 9", they have the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability instead.
Kult of Speed.restrictions: A unit cannot be targeted by this and the Blitza Fire Stratagem in the same phase.

Kult of Speed.name: FULL THROTTLE!
Kult of Speed.when: Your Charge phase, just after a SPEED FREEKS unit from your army ends a Charge move.
Kult of Speed.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

Kult of Speed.name: MORE GITZ OVER ’ERE!
Kult of Speed.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Kult of Speed.target: One Speed Freeks unit from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Kult of Speed.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

Kult of Speed.name: SPEEDIEST FREEKS
Kult of Speed.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Kult of Speed.target: One Speed Freeks or Trukk unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Kult of Speed.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save. If your unit is a VEHICLE unit with an unmodified Toughness characteristic of 8 or less, until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save instead.

Kult of Speed.name: SQUIG FLINGIN’
Kult of Speed.when: Your Movement phase, just after a SPEED FREEKS or TRUKK unit from your army ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Kult of Speed.target: That Speed Freeks or Trukk unit.
Kult of Speed.effect: Select one enemy unit within 9" of your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test and, when doing so, subtract 1 from the result.

More Dakka!.name: CALL DAT DAKKA?
More Dakka!.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
More Dakka!.target: One ORKS unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit’s attacks.
More Dakka!.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

More Dakka!.name: GET STUCK IN, LADZ!
More Dakka!.target: One ORKS unit from your army (excluding Gretchin units).
More Dakka!.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, the Waaagh! is active for your unit, even if you have already called a Waaagh! this battle. Designer’s Note: This means that any abilities that are in effect while the Waaagh! is active for your army will be in effect for your unit.

More Dakka!.name: HUGE SHOW-OFFS
More Dakka!.target: One Orks Walker unit (excluding Killa Kans) from your army.
More Dakka!.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, improve your unit’s Move, Leadership and Objective Control characteristics by 1, and each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

More Dakka!.name: LONG, UNCONTROLLED BURSTS
More Dakka!.target: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
More Dakka!.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

More Dakka!.name: ORKS IS STILL ORKS
More Dakka!.target: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
More Dakka!.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If that enemy unit is within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.

More Dakka!.name: SPESHUL SHELLS
More Dakka!.target: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
More Dakka!.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets the closest eligible target within 18", improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.

Ramship Raiders.name: EAGER TO FIGHT
Ramship Raiders.when: Your Movement phase, in the Reinforcements step, just after an ORKS unit from your army is set up in an Entry Zone.
Ramship Raiders.effect: Your unit can make an Advance move.

Ramship Raiders.name: ENRAGED RUSH
Ramship Raiders.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Ramship Raiders.target: One BOYz unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Ramship Raiders.effect: Your unit can make an Enraged Rush move. To do so, roll one D6: your unit can be moved a distance in inches up to the result, but must end that move as close as possible to the attacking unit. When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit, but only that enemy unit.

Ramship Raiders.name: PILE THROUGH
Ramship Raiders.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
Ramship Raiders.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit has the Fights First ability.

Ramship Raiders.name: RAMBOYZ RAMPAGE
Ramship Raiders.target: One BOYz unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Ramship Raiders.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced and each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll; instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

Speedwaaagh!.name: DED KILLY CONSTRUCTION
Speedwaaagh!.target: One Speed Freeks or Trukk unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Speedwaaagh!.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LANCE] ability and, if your unit made a Charge move this turn, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of those weapons.

Speedwaaagh!.name: DUST TRAILS
Speedwaaagh!.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Speedwaaagh!.target: One ORKS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Speedwaaagh!.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Benefit of Cover.

Speedwaaagh!.name: EVASIVE MANOOVA
Speedwaaagh!.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Speedwaaagh!.target: One Speed Freeks or Trukk unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Speedwaaagh!.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Speedwaaagh!.name: MOBILE DAKKASTORM
Speedwaaagh!.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a Speed Freeks or Trukk unit from your army has shot.
Speedwaaagh!.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks (excluding attacks made with Indirect Fire weapons). Until the end of the phase, each time a model in a SPEED FREEKS or TRUKK unit from your army makes an attack that targets that unit, improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 2.

Speedwaaagh!.name: ON DA MOVE
Speedwaaagh!.target: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Speedwaaagh!.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back or Advanced (unless it used its turbo this turn).

Speedwaaagh!.name: SPESHUL AMMO
Speedwaaagh!.target: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Speedwaaagh!.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit (excluding Torrent weapons) have the [ANTI-MONSTER 4+] and [ANTI-VEHICLE 4+] abilities.

Taktikal Brigade.name: DAT’S OURS
Taktikal Brigade.target: One ORKS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Taktikal Brigade.effect: Until the start of the next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit.

Taktikal Brigade.name: DED SNEAKY
Taktikal Brigade.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Taktikal Brigade.target: One Kommandos or Stormboyz unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Taktikal Brigade.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Taktikal Brigade.name: FIGHT PROPPA
Taktikal Brigade.target: One Orks Infantry or Orks Mounted unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Taktikal Brigade.effect: Select the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS] ability. Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.

Taktikal Brigade.name: KRUNCHIN’ DESCENT
Taktikal Brigade.when: Your Charge phase, just after a STORMBOYZ unit from your army ends a Charge move.
Taktikal Brigade.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

Taktikal Brigade.name: ON TO DA NEXT
Taktikal Brigade.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back.
Taktikal Brigade.target: One ORKS unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase.
Taktikal Brigade.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

Taktikal Brigade.name: TAKTIKAL RETREAT
Taktikal Brigade.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army Falls Back.
Taktikal Brigade.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

War Horde.name: ’ARD AS NAILS
War Horde.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
War Horde.target: One ORKS unit from your army (excluding Grots, Monster and Vehicle units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
War Horde.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

War Horde.name: CAREEN!
War Horde.when: Any phase, just after an Orks Vehicle unit from your army with the Deadly Demise ability is destroyed.
War Horde.target: That destroyed ORKS VEHICLE unit, if you roll a 6 for its Deadly Demise ability. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
War Horde.effect: Your unit can make a Normal or Fall Back move before its Deadly Demise ability is resolved, and before any embarked units perform an Emergency Disembarkation. When making this move, your unit can move over enemy units (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) as if they were not there.

War Horde.name: ERE WE GO
War Horde.target: One Orks Infantry unit from your army.
War Horde.effect: Until the end of the turn, add 2 to Advance and Charge rolls made for your unit.

War Horde.name: MOB RULE
War Horde.target: One Mob unit from your army that contains 10 or more models and is not Below Half-strength.
War Horde.effect: Select one friendly Battle-shocked Orks Infantry unit within 6" of that MOB unit. That ORKS INFANTRY unit is no longer Battle-shocked.

War Horde.name: ORKS IS NEVER BEATEN
War Horde.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
War Horde.target: One ORKS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
War Horde.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making attacks, and is then removed from play.

War Horde.name: UNBRIDLED CARNAGE
War Horde.target: One ORKS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
War Horde.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

Freeblade Company.name: FLANKING MANOEUVRES
Freeblade Company.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Freeblade Company.target: One Armiger unit from your army that is within 9" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Freeblade Company.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Freeblade Company.name: FULL TILT
Freeblade Company.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army.
Freeblade Company.effect: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit, or 9" instead if your unit is an Armiger or Destrier unit.

Freeblade Company.name: NOBLE SACRIFICE
Freeblade Company.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this Stratagem even though it was just destroyed.
Freeblade Company.effect: Your unit’s Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 4+, adding 1 to the result if it is an Armiger unit, instead of only a 6.

Freeblade Company.name: POINT‑BLANK BARRAGE
Freeblade Company.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Freeblade Company.effect: Until the end of the phase, when making ranged attacks with Blast weapons, models in your unit can target enemy units within Engagement Range of your unit (provided no other friendly units are also within Engagement Range of that enemy unit). In addition, until the end of the phase, your unit does not suffer the penalty to its Hit rolls for being within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, but each time a model in your unit makes an attack with a Blast weapon that targets a unit within Engagement Range of your unit, on an unmodified Hit roll of 1, your unit suffers 1 mortal wound after all of its attacks have been resolved.

Freeblade Company.name: STRENGTH FROM EXILE
Freeblade Company.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Freeblade Company.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Freeblade Company.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if there are no other friendly units within 9" of your unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

Freeblade Company.name: SURVIVOR OF STRIFE
Freeblade Company.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Freeblade Company.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Freeblade Company.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Gate Warden Lance.name: DRIVE THEM OUT!
Gate Warden Lance.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Gate Warden Lance.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Gate Warden Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit on your defensive line, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

Gate Warden Lance.name: FORTRESS OF INTIMIDATION
Gate Warden Lance.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
Gate Warden Lance.target: One Imperial Knights Titanic unit from your army that is on your defensive line.
Gate Warden Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit selects your unit as a target of a charge, that unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

Gate Warden Lance.name: LANCEBREAKER
Gate Warden Lance.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Gate Warden Lance.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks and is on your defensive line.
Gate Warden Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greaterthan the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll

Gate Warden Lance.name: MARSHAL THE DEFENCE
Gate Warden Lance.target: Up to two Imperial Knights units from your army that have not been selected to move this phase.
Gate Warden Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in your units.

Gate Warden Lance.name: STEADFAST SUPERIORITY
Gate Warden Lance.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, that is on your defensive line and that has not already been selected to fight this phase.
Gate Warden Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

Gate Warden Lance.name: TITANIC BOMBARDMENT
Gate Warden Lance.target: One Imperial Knights Titanic unit from your army that Remained Stationary this turn, that is on your defensive line and that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Gate Warden Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability.

Questor Forgepact.name: AGGRESSION BEGETS AGGRESSION
Questor Forgepact.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army or one Imperial Knights Character unit from your army and one friendly Adeptus Mechanicus unit that is within 6" of that unit.
Questor Forgepact.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your units have the [ASSAULT] ability.

Questor Forgepact.name: BONDED IMPERATIVE
Questor Forgepact.when: Your Command phase, just before an Imperial Knights Character unit from your army uses a Bondsman ability.
Questor Forgepact.effect: When selecting targets for that use of that Bondsman ability, you can select one friendly Adeptus Mechanicus unit within 12" of your unit in addition, or instead of selecting one Armiger model. Until the start of your next Command phase, every model in that ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit is affected by that Bondsman ability.
Questor Forgepact.restrictions: You cannot target a Knight Preceptor with this Stratagem.

Questor Forgepact.name: MACHINE FOCUS
Questor Forgepact.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army.
Questor Forgepact.effect:
Until the start of your next turn, your unit
can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: the Weapon Skill or Ballistic Skill characteristics of weapons equipped by its models; any Hit roll or Wound roll made for it.

Questor Forgepact.name: OMNISSIAH’S GRACE
Questor Forgepact.when: Any phase, just after a mortal wound is allocated to an Imperial Knights or Adeptus Mechanicus unit from your army.
Questor Forgepact.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds.

Questor Forgepact.name: THRONEGHEIST FURY
Questor Forgepact.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is set up or ends a Normal, Advance, or Fall Back move.
Questor Forgepact.target: One Imperial Knights Titanic unit from your army that is within 24" of and visible to that enemy unit.
Questor Forgepact.effect: Select one ranged weapon equipped by a model in your unit. That model can shoot at that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target). When doing so, that model can only make attacks with that weapon and each time it makes a ranged attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 is required to score a hit, irrespective of the attacking weapon’s Ballistic Skill or any modifiers.

Questor Forgepact.name: VENGEANCE OF THE MACHINE CULT
Questor Forgepact.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
Questor Forgepact.effect: Until the end of the battle, the enemy unit that destroyed your unit is Marked. Each time an Adeptus Mechanicus model from your army makes an attack that targets a Marked unit, that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

Questoris Companions.name: COURAGEOUS STAND
Questoris Companions.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Questoris Companions.target: One Imperial Knights Titanic unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Questoris Companions.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.

Questoris Companions.name: DRIVEN BY THE PAST
Questoris Companions.target: One Imperial Knights Titanic unit from your army.
Questoris Companions.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Questoris Companions.name: HERO’S TREAD
Questoris Companions.target: One Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army that is within range of an objective marker you control.
Questoris Companions.effect: Your Level of Control over that objective marker is 5 (unless it would otherwise be higher), until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

Questoris Companions.name: MOMENT OF GLORY
Questoris Companions.when: Fight phase, just before an Imperial Knights Titanic unit from your army Consolidates.
Questoris Companions.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Consolidates, models in it can move an additional 3" provided your unit can end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

Questoris Companions.name: TITANIC DUEL
Questoris Companions.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Questoris Companions.target: One Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Questoris Companions.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your model makes an attack that targets a MONSTER, TITANIC or WALKER unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

Questoris Companions.name: UNSTOPPABLE WARRIOR
Questoris Companions.when: Your Movement phase, just after an Imperial Knights Titanic unit from your army Falls Back.
Questoris Companions.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Spearhead-At-Arms.name: EXEMPLAR’S WISDOM
Spearhead-At-Arms.when: Your Shooting phase, just after an Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army has shot.
Spearhead-At-Arms.target: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC model, and one or more friendly Armiger models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.
Spearhead-At-Arms.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time one of your ARMIGER models makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Spearhead-At-Arms.name: LET DUTY BE YOUR SHIELD
Spearhead-At-Arms.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Spearhead-At-Arms.target: One Armiger unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking units attacks.
Spearhead-At-Arms.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Spearhead-At-Arms.name: MANTLE OF THE MENTOR
