Spearhead-At-Arms.target: One Armiger model from your army, or one Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.
Spearhead-At-Arms.effect: Until the end of the phase, your ARMIGER models are eligible to shoot in a turn in which they Fell Back.

Spearhead-At-Arms.name: SQUIRES OFTHE HUNT
Spearhead-At-Arms.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Spearhead-At-Arms.target: One Armiger model from your army, or one Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.
Spearhead-At-Arms.effect: For each of your ARMIGER models that is within 9" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, remove that ARMIGER model from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Spearhead-At-Arms.name: THIN THEIR RANKS
Spearhead-At-Arms.target: One Armiger model from your army, or one Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.
Spearhead-At-Arms.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by your ARMIGER models have the [RAPID FIRE 1] ability.

Spearhead-At-Arms.name: VIRTUE OF COURAGE
Spearhead-At-Arms.target: One Armiger model from your army, or one Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.
Spearhead-At-Arms.effect: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, each time one of your ARMIGER models makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.

Valourstrike Lance.name: FULL TILT
Valourstrike Lance.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Valourstrike Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 2" to the Move characteristic of your models and add 2 to Advance rolls made for those model’s units.

Valourstrike Lance.name: ROTATE ION SHIELDS
Valourstrike Lance.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Valourstrike Lance.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Valourstrike Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

Valourstrike Lance.name: RUN THEM THROUGH!
Valourstrike Lance.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Valourstrike Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by your models have the [LANCE] ability.

Valourstrike Lance.name: TACTICAL FOIL
Valourstrike Lance.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Valourstrike Lance.target: One Imperial Knights model from your army that is within 9" of that unit.
Valourstrike Lance.effect: Your model can make a Normal move of up to D6".

Valourstrike Lance.name: THUNDERSTOMP
Valourstrike Lance.target: One Imperial Knights model from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Valourstrike Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, the Attacks characteristic of any armoured Feet melee weapons equipped by your model is 8, the Attacks characteristic of any titanic Feet melee weapons equipped by your model is 12, and improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of those weapons by 1.

Valourstrike Lance.name: VOW OF RETRIBUTION
Valourstrike Lance.target: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Valourstrike Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by your models have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

Helhunt Lance.name: BEASTHIDE MANIFESTATION
Helhunt Lance.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Helhunt Lance.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Helhunt Lance.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Helhunt Lance.name: CONTEMPTUOUS VOLLEYS
Helhunt Lance.when: Your Movement phase, just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army Falls Back.
Helhunt Lance.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Helhunt Lance.name: FERAL ARROGANCE
Helhunt Lance.when: Any phase, just after a mortal wound is allocated to a Chaos Knights unit from your army.
Helhunt Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds.

Helhunt Lance.name: FLUSH THE QUARRY
Helhunt Lance.target: One Titanic Chaos Knights unit from your army and up to three friendly War Dog units within 6" of that Titanic Chaos Knights unit.
Helhunt Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time one of those War Dog units makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, its models can move through models and terrain features. When doing so, they can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

Helhunt Lance.name: GOADED BEAST
Helhunt Lance.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Helhunt Lance.target: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that lost one or more wounds as a result of those attacks.
Helhunt Lance.effect: Your unit can make a Surge move. To do so, roll one D6: models in your unit move a number of inches up to the result, but your unit must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT). When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

Helhunt Lance.name: MERCILESS FUSILLADE
Helhunt Lance.when: Start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
Helhunt Lance.target: One Titanic Chaos Knights unit from your army, and up to two friendly War Dog units, that have not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Helhunt Lance.effect: Select one enemy unit that is an eligible target for each of those CHAOS KNIGHTS units. Until the end of the phase, each time one of those Chaos Knights units is selected to shoot or fight, if that enemy unit is an eligible target, you can only select that enemy unit as the target for all of those attacks and those attacks have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

Houndpack Lance.name: ANIMALISTIC RAGE
Houndpack Lance.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a War Dog unit from your army that has not yet fought is destroyed.
Houndpack Lance.target: That WAR DOG unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
Houndpack Lance.effect: Before resolving your unit’s Deadly Demise ability, it can either shoot or fight. When doing so, it must target only the enemy unit that just destroyed it, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target. After it has done so and after any Consolidation moves have been made, resolve your unit’s Deadly Demise ability as normal.

Houndpack Lance.name: CUNNING HUNTER
Houndpack Lance.when: Your Movement phase, just after a War Dog unit from your army Falls Back.
Houndpack Lance.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Houndpack Lance.name: ENCIRCLING PACK
Houndpack Lance.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Houndpack Lance.target: One War Dog unit from your army that is wholly within 12" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Houndpack Lance.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Houndpack Lance.name: HARRYING HOUNDS
Houndpack Lance.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Houndpack Lance.target: One War Dog unit from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit.
Houndpack Lance.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

Houndpack Lance.name: HUNGRY FOR COMBAT
Houndpack Lance.target: Two or more War Dog units from your army within Engagement Range of the same enemy unit.
Houndpack Lance.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of those WAR DOG units. Until the end of the phase, models in those WAR DOG units can only target that enemy unit, but each time a model in one of those WAR DOG units makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

Houndpack Lance.name: VOX-HOWL
Houndpack Lance.when: Start of the Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
Houndpack Lance.target: One War Dog Character unit from your army.
Houndpack Lance.effect: Each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test. Each friendly WAR DOG unit that is within 6" of your unit and is Battle-shocked must take a Leadership test; if that test is passed, that unit is no longer Battle-shocked.
Houndpack Lance.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.

Iconoclast Fiefdom.name: AVENGE THE MASTERS!
Iconoclast Fiefdom.target: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
Iconoclast Fiefdom.effect: Until the end of the battle, the enemy unit that destroyed your unit is Marked. Each time a Damned model from your army makes an attack that targets a Marked unit, that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

Iconoclast Fiefdom.name: PRESERVE THE IDOLS
Iconoclast Fiefdom.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Iconoclast Fiefdom.target: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit.
Iconoclast Fiefdom.effect: Select one Damned unit from your army that is not Battle-shocked, not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and is within 6" of your unit. That DAMNED unit can make a Normal move of up to 6", but it must end this move closer to that enemy unit than when it started the move.

Iconoclast Fiefdom.name: SOUL HUNGER
Iconoclast Fiefdom.when: Fight phase, just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army has fought.
Iconoclast Fiefdom.effect: If one or more models were destroyed as a result of those attacks, your unit regains up to D3 lost wounds. If one or more models from Battle-shocked units were destroyed as a result of those attacks, your unit regains up to D3+2 lost wounds instead.

Iconoclast Fiefdom.name: UNRESTRAINED RAGE
Iconoclast Fiefdom.when: Your Movement phase, just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army Advances or Falls Back.
Iconoclast Fiefdom.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

Iconoclast Fiefdom.name: WORTHLESS CHATTEL
Iconoclast Fiefdom.target: One Damned unit from your army.
Iconoclast Fiefdom.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units are not considered to be within Engagement Range of your unit for the purposes of selecting targets of ranged weapons. Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model loses a wound, while that model’s unit is within Engagement Range of your unit, roll one D6: on a 4+, one model from your unit is destroyed after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.

Iconoclast Fiefdom.name: WRETCHED MASSES
Iconoclast Fiefdom.target: One Damned unit (excluding Accursed Cultists) from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
Iconoclast Fiefdom.effect: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength and with all of its wounds remaining.
Iconoclast Fiefdom.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle. This Stratagem cannot be used to return destroyed CHARACTER units to Attached units.

Infernal Lance.name: CORRUPTING TAINT
Infernal Lance.when: Your Command phase, just after a Chaos Knights Character unit from your army makes a Malefic Surge.
Infernal Lance.effect: Select one objective marker your unit is within range of that you control. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

Infernal Lance.name: DIABOLIC BULWARK
Infernal Lance.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Infernal Lance.target: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Infernal Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

Infernal Lance.name: HELLFORGED CONSTRUCTION
Infernal Lance.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Infernal Lance.target: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Infernal Lance.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Infernal Lance.name: PROFANE SYMBIOSIS
Infernal Lance.target: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that is not Empowered.
Infernal Lance.effect: Your unit makes a Malefic Surge.
Infernal Lance.restrictions: You cannot select the same unit as the target of this Stratagem more than once per battle round.

Infernal Lance.name: UNLEASH BALEFIRE
Infernal Lance.target: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Infernal Lance.effect: After your unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test; if the test is failed, until the end of your opponent’s next turn, it is aflame. While a unit is aflame, subtract 2" from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it.

Infernal Lance.name: WARP VISION
Infernal Lance.target: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Infernal Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

Lords of Dread.name: CLAIMED FOR THE DARK GODS
Lords of Dread.target: One Chaos Knights Character unit from your army that is within range of one or more objective markers you control.
Lords of Dread.effect: Select one of those objective markers. That objective marker remains under your control, with a Level of Control of 5 (unless it would otherwise be higher), until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

Lords of Dread.name: CRUSHED LIKE VERMIN
Lords of Dread.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Chaos Knights Character unit from your army ends a Normal move.
Lords of Dread.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) that your unit moved over during that move and roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound. If one or more models are destroyed as a result of this Stratagem, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.

Lords of Dread.name: RUNES OF DISDAIN
Lords of Dread.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Lords of Dread.target: One Chaos Knights Character unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Lords of Dread.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

Lords of Dread.name: SPITEFUL DEMISE
Lords of Dread.when: Any phase, just after a Chaos Knights Character unit from your army is destroyed.
Lords of Dread.target: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
Lords of Dread.effect: When rolling to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your unit’s Deadly Demise ability, that model’s Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of a 4+ instead of on a 6.

Lords of Dread.name: TITANIC DUEL
Lords of Dread.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Lords of Dread.target: One Chaos Knights Character unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Lords of Dread.effect: Select one enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1. Each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if that enemy unit is TITANIC, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.

Lords of Dread.name: TROPHY HUNTER
Lords of Dread.when: Fight phase, just before a Chaos Knights Character unit from your army consolidates.
Lords of Dread.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Consolidates, models in it can move an additional 3" as long as your unit can end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

Traitoris Lance.name: A LONG LEASH
Traitoris Lance.target: One Abhorrent unit from your army and up to two friendly War Dog units.
Traitoris Lance.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, those WAR DOG units are treated as being within range of any Aura abilities your ABHORRENT unit has.

Traitoris Lance.name: CONQUERORS WITHOUT MERCY
Traitoris Lance.target: One Chaos Knights model from your army that made a Charge move this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase.
Traitoris Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by your model by 1. After your model has finished making its attacks this phase, if it destroyed one or more enemy units this phase, each enemy unit within 6" of your model must take a Battle-shock test.

Traitoris Lance.name: DISDAIN FOR THE WEAK
Traitoris Lance.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Traitoris Lance.target: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Traitoris Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against attacks made by Battle-shocked models.

Traitoris Lance.name: IMPERIOUS ADVANCE
Traitoris Lance.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
Traitoris Lance.target: Up to two War Dog units from your army or one Titanic Chaos Knights unit from your army.
Traitoris Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of your units makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move through models and terrain features. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but, unless it made a Charge move, cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed (the Super-heavy Walker ability does not apply while using this Stratagem).

Traitoris Lance.name: PTERRORSHADES
Traitoris Lance.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test.
Traitoris Lance.target: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that is within 12" of that enemy unit.
Traitoris Lance.effect: Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound and one model in your unit regains up to 1 lost wound.
Traitoris Lance.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.

Traitoris Lance.name: STORM OF DARKNESS
Traitoris Lance.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Traitoris Lance.target: One Chaos Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Traitoris Lance.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Stealth ability, and each time an attack targets your unit, models in it have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

1st Company Task Force.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
1st Company Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
1st Company Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
1st Company Task Force.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

1st Company Task Force.name: DUTY AND HONOUR
1st Company Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR, BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD, STERNGUARD VETERAN SQUAD or VANGUARD VETERAN SQUAD unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.
1st Company Task Force.effect: That objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.

1st Company Task Force.name: HEROES OF THE CHAPTER
1st Company Task Force.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
1st Company Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR, BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD, STERNGUARD VETERAN SQUAD or VANGUARD VETERAN SQUAD unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
1st Company Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. If your unit is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

1st Company Task Force.name: LEGENDARY FORTITUDE
1st Company Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.
1st Company Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR, BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD, STERNGUARD VETERAN SQUAD or VANGUARD VETERAN SQUAD unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
1st Company Task Force.effect: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

1st Company Task Force.name: ORBITAL TELEPORTARIUM
1st Company Task Force.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
1st Company Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit from your army.
1st Company Task Force.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. It will arrive back on the battlefield in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase using the Deep Strike ability.
1st Company Task Force.restrictions: You cannot select a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

1st Company Task Force.name: TERRIFYING PROFICIENCY
1st Company Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR, BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD, STERNGUARD VETERAN SQUAD or VANGUARD VETERAN SQUAD unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn and destroyed one or more enemy units this phase.
1st Company Task Force.effect: In your opponent’s next Command phase, each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test. If the unit taking that test is Below Half-strength, subtract 1 from that test. Enemy units affected by this Stratagem do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

Angelic Inheritors.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Angelic Inheritors.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Angelic Inheritors.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Angelic Inheritors.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Angelic Inheritors.name: FOCUSED FURY
Angelic Inheritors.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Angelic Inheritors.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. If your unit is a Character unit, until the end of the phase, those weapons have the [LANCE] ability as well.

Angelic Inheritors.name: IN THE SHADOW OF GREAT WINGS
Angelic Inheritors.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Angelic Inheritors.target: One Adeptus Astartes Character unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Angelic Inheritors.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

Angelic Inheritors.name: INSTANT OF GRACE
Angelic Inheritors.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army.
Angelic Inheritors.effect: Select one non-CHARACTER model in your unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, your model has the Character keyword. Designer’s Note: While in effect, your model’s unit is therefore a CHARACTER unit, meaning it can interact with the Legacy of the Angel Detachment rule, in addition to other rules that interact with CHARACTER units.

Angelic Inheritors.name: STRIKE NOW FOR GLORY
Angelic Inheritors.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Angelic Inheritors.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

Angelic Inheritors.name: UNTO THE BURNING SKIES
Angelic Inheritors.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Angelic Inheritors.target: One Adeptus Astartes Jump Pack unit from your army. You cannot target a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, unless it is The Sanguinor.
Angelic Inheritors.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Anvil Siege Force.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Anvil Siege Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Anvil Siege Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Anvil Siege Force.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Anvil Siege Force.name: BATTLE DRILL RECALL
Anvil Siege Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Anvil Siege Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. If your unit Remained Stationary this turn, then until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

Anvil Siege Force.name: HAIL OF VENGEANCE
Anvil Siege Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.
Anvil Siege Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Anvil Siege Force.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

Anvil Siege Force.name: NO THREAT TOO GREAT
Anvil Siege Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Anvil Siege Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

Anvil Siege Force.name: NOT ONE BACKWARDS STEP
Anvil Siege Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit from your army within range of an objective marker.
Anvil Siege Force.effect: Until the end of the turn, double the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit, but it must Remain Stationary this turn.

Anvil Siege Force.name: RIGID DISCIPLINE
Anvil Siege Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Anvil Siege Force.effect: Your unit can immediately make a Fall Back move of up to 6".
Anvil Siege Force.restrictions: When making that move, your unit must end that move either wholly within your deployment zone or within range of an objective marker.

Armoured Speartip.name: ADVANCED DEPLOYMENT
Armoured Speartip.target: One Adeptus Astartes Transport unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Armoured Speartip.effect: Until the end of the phase, units can disembark from your TRANSPORT after it has Advanced. Units that do so count as having made a Normal move this phase, and cannot declare a charge in the same turn (unless your TRANSPORT has the Assault Ramp ability), but can otherwise act normally.

Armoured Speartip.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Armoured Speartip.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Armoured Speartip.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Armoured Speartip.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Armoured Speartip.name: CERAMITE SLEDGEHAMMER
Armoured Speartip.target: One Adeptus Astartes Transport unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Armoured Speartip.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal or Advance move, it can move horizontally through terrain features. In addition, if your unit is a Heavy Transport, when making this move, your unit can move through enemy models (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) and can move within Engagement Range of such models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

Armoured Speartip.name: MACHINE WRATH
Armoured Speartip.when: Any phase, just after a Heavy Transport unit from your army with the Deadly Demise ability is destroyed.
Armoured Speartip.target: That HEAVY TRANSPORT unit, if you rolled a 6 for its Deadly Demise ability. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
Armoured Speartip.effect: Your unit can make a Normal or Fall Back move before its Deadly Demise ability is resolved, and before any embarked units perform an Emergency Disembarkation. When making this move, your unit can move through enemy models (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) and can move within Engagement Range of such models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.

Armoured Speartip.name: PURGATION DOCTRINE
Armoured Speartip.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Armoured Speartip.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll (if your unit disembarked from a Heavy Transport this turn, add 1 to the Wound roll as well).

Armoured Speartip.name: RAPID EMBARKATION
Armoured Speartip.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, and one friendly Heavy Transport it is able to embark within.
Armoured Speartip.effect: If your ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is wholly within 6" of that HEAVY TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.

Bastion Task Force.name: CODEX DISCIPLINE
Bastion Task Force.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Bastion Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Bastion Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If that target is auspex scanned, re-roll a Wound roll of 1 as well.

Bastion Task Force.name: GUIDED DISRUPTION
Bastion Task Force.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit from your army has finished making its attacks.
Bastion Task Force.effect: When an enemy unit is auspex scanned as a result of those attacks this turn, if that enemy unit does not have the MONSTER or VEHICLE keywords, until the start of your next turn, it is pinned. While a unit is pinned, subtract 2 from that unit’s Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that unit.

Bastion Task Force.name: HERESY UNDONE
Bastion Task Force.when: Your Shooting phase or your Charge phase.
Bastion Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding Battleline units) from your army.
Bastion Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back. If it does, every target of that charge and every target of those attacks must be an auspex scanned unit.

Bastion Task Force.name: LIGHT OF VENGEANCE
Bastion Task Force.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Bastion Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Bastion Task Force.effect: Select the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have that ability while targeting an auspex scanned unit or if the bearer has the Battleline keyword.

Bastion Task Force.name: SHOCK BOMBARDMENT
Bastion Task Force.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit from your army finished making its attacks.
Bastion Task Force.effect: When an enemy unit is auspex scanned as a result of those attacks this turn, until the start of your next turn, it is suppressed. While a unit is suppressed, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Black Spear Task Force.name: ADAPTIVE TACTICS
Black Spear Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Black Spear Task Force
Black Spear Task Force.target: Up to two Kill Team units from your army, or one other ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
Black Spear Task Force.effect: For each unit targeted, select Furor Tactics, Malleus Tactics or Purgatus Tactics. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Mission Tactic is active for that unit instead of any Mission Tactic that is active for your army.

Black Spear Task Force.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Black Spear Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Black Spear Task Force
Black Spear Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Black Spear Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Black Spear Task Force.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Black Spear Task Force.name: DRAGONFIRE ROUNDS
Black Spear Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Black Spear Task Force
Black Spear Task Force.target: One Kill Team unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Black Spear Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.
Black Spear Task Force.restrictions: You cannot select any units that have already been targeted with either the Kraken Rounds or Hellfire Rounds Stratagems this phase.

Black Spear Task Force.name: HELLFIRE ROUNDS
Black Spear Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Black Spear Task Force
Black Spear Task Force.target: One Kill Team unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Black Spear Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons (excluding Devastating Wounds weapons) equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI-INFANTRY 2+] and [ANTI-MONSTER 5+] abilities.
Black Spear Task Force.restrictions: You cannot select any units that have already been targeted with either the Kraken Rounds or Dragonfire Rounds Stratagems this phase.

Black Spear Task Force.name: KRAKEN ROUNDS
Black Spear Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Black Spear Task Force
Black Spear Task Force.target: One Kill Team unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Black Spear Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1 and improve the Range characteristic of those weapons by 6".
Black Spear Task Force.restrictions: You cannot select any units that have already been targeted with either the Dragonfire Rounds or Hellfire Rounds Stratagems this phase.

Black Spear Task Force.name: SITE-TO-SITE TELEPORTATION
Black Spear Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Black Spear Task Force
Black Spear Task Force.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Black Spear Task Force.target: Up to two Kill Team units from your army, or one other Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army, if those units are not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Black Spear Task Force.effect: Remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves. Until the end of your next Movement phase, models in those units that do not have the Deep Strike ability have the Deep Strike ability.

Blade of Ultramar.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Blade of Ultramar.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Blade of Ultramar.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Blade of Ultramar.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Blade of Ultramar.name: COURAGE AND HONOUR!
Blade of Ultramar.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LANCE] ability. If your unit is under the effects of the Assault Doctrine, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of such weapons by 1 as well.

Blade of Ultramar.name: EXEMPLARY VIGILANCE
Blade of Ultramar.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Blade of Ultramar.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability. If your unit is under the effects of the Devastator Doctrine, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of such weapons by 1 as well.

Blade of Ultramar.name: PRACTICAL TACTICS
Blade of Ultramar.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Blade of Ultramar.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry or Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and is within 9" of the enemy unit that just ended that move.
Blade of Ultramar.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", or a Normal move of up to 6" instead if it is under the effects of the Tactical Doctrine.

Blade of Ultramar.name: TACTICAL FORESIGHT
Blade of Ultramar.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Blade of Ultramar.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Blade of Ultramar.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than or equal to the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Blade of Ultramar.name: ULTRAMARIAN ADAPTIVITY
Blade of Ultramar.effect: Select the Devastator Doctrine, Tactical Doctrine or Assault Doctrine. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Combat Doctrine is active for your unit instead of any other Combat Doctrine that is active for your army, even if you have already selected that Combat Doctrine this battle.

Boarding Strike.name: CERAMITE BULWARK
Boarding Strike.target: One Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Boarding Strike.effect: Select any number of models in your unit. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the selected models and each time you select targets for attacks made by those models, they must target an enemy unit that is wholly on the opposite side of a Hatchway from them.

Boarding Strike.name: DUTY AND DEFIANCE
Boarding Strike.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Boarding Strike.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Boarding Strike.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit has the Battleline keyword: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Boarding Strike.name: IN THE EMPEROR’S NAME
Boarding Strike.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Boarding Strike.target: One Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker and was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Boarding Strike.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

Boarding Strike.name: VOX-AMPLIFIED ROAR
Boarding Strike.when: Your Charge phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army declares a charge.
Boarding Strike.effect: Each target of that charge must take a Battle-shock test.

Ceramite Sentinels.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Ceramite Sentinels.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Ceramite Sentinels.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Ceramite Sentinels.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Ceramite Sentinels.name: AUGMENTED TARGETING
Ceramite Sentinels.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Ceramite Sentinels.effect: Select either the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS] abilities. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability. If your unit is ENTRENCHED, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [LETHAL HITS] abilities instead.

Ceramite Sentinels.name: EVASIVE REPOSITIONING
Ceramite Sentinels.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Ceramite Sentinels.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry or Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Ceramite Sentinels.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6". If your unit is ENTRENCHED, you can re-roll the D6 to determine how far your unit can move.

Ceramite Sentinels.name: PRIORITY STRIKE
Ceramite Sentinels.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Ceramite Sentinels.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry or Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Ceramite Sentinels.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

Ceramite Sentinels.name: STAND TO THE END
Ceramite Sentinels.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Ceramite Sentinels.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Ceramite Sentinels.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if it is an ENTRENCHED unit: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Ceramite Sentinels.name: UNYIELDING MIGHT
Ceramite Sentinels.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Ceramite Sentinels.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristics of models in your unit.

Inner Circle Task Force.target: One Deathwing Infantry unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Inner Circle Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than your unit’s Toughness characteristic, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Inner Circle Task Force.name: WRATH OF THE LION
Inner Circle Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Inner Circle Task Force
Inner Circle Task Force.target: One Deathwing INFANTRY unit from your army that just ended a Charge move.
Inner Circle Task Force.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit and roll one D6 for each model in your unit, adding 1 to the result if that enemy unit is within range of your Vowed objective marker: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 3 mortal wounds).

Ironstorm Spearhead.name: ANCIENT FURY
Ironstorm Spearhead.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES WALKER model from your army.
Ironstorm Spearhead.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, improve your model’s Move, Toughness, Leadership and Objective Control characteristics by 1 and each time your model makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

Ironstorm Spearhead.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Ironstorm Spearhead.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Ironstorm Spearhead.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Ironstorm Spearhead.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Ironstorm Spearhead.name: MERCY IS WEAKNESS
Ironstorm Spearhead.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Ironstorm Spearhead.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Ironstorm Spearhead.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability, and when making such an attack, if the attacking model is a VEHICLE, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

Ironstorm Spearhead.name: POWER OF THE MACHINE SPIRIT
Ironstorm Spearhead.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.
Ironstorm Spearhead.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit from your army that was reduced to Below Half-strength as a result of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Ironstorm Spearhead.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but must target only that enemy unit when doing so, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

Ironstorm Spearhead.name: UNBOWED CONVICTION
Ironstorm Spearhead.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is below its Starting Strength.
Ironstorm Spearhead.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit can ignore any or all modifiers to its characteristics and/or to any roll or test made for it (excluding modifiers to saving throws).

Ironstorm Spearhead.name: VENGEFUL ANIMUS
Ironstorm Spearhead.when: Any phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability is destroyed.
Ironstorm Spearhead.target: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
Ironstorm Spearhead.effect: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted.

Liberator Assault Group.name: AGGRESSIVE ONSLAUGHT
Liberator Assault Group.when: Your Movement phase, just after an Adeptus Astartes unit from your army has Advanced.
Liberator Assault Group.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to either shoot or declare a charge, even though it Advanced. You can instead choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst; if it does, it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it) and until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to both shoot and declare a charge, even though it Advanced.

Liberator Assault Group.name: ANGELIC GRACE
Liberator Assault Group.when: Any phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army has a mortal wound allocated to it.
Liberator Assault Group.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds.

Liberator Assault Group.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Liberator Assault Group.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Liberator Assault Group.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Liberator Assault Group.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Liberator Assault Group.name: RED RAMPAGE
Liberator Assault Group.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Liberator Assault Group.effect: Select either the [LANCE] or [LETHAL HITS] abilities. Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability. You can instead choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst; if it does, then it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it) and until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LANCE] and [LETHAL HITS] abilities.

Liberator Assault Group.name: RELENTLESS ASSAULT
Liberator Assault Group.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army Falls Back.
Liberator Assault Group.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to either shoot or declare a charge even though it Fell Back. You can instead choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst; if it does, it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it) and until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to both shoot and declare a charge, even though it Fell Back.

Liberator Assault Group.name: SAVAGE ECHOES
Liberator Assault Group.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was just charged by an enemy unit.
Liberator Assault Group.effect: Select either the Strength or Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit. Until the end of the turn, add 1 to the selected characteristic. You can instead choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst; if it does, it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it) and until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.

Librarius Conclave.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Librarius Conclave.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Librarius Conclave.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Librarius Conclave.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Librarius Conclave.name: ASSAIL
Librarius Conclave.target: One Adeptus Astartes Psyker unit from your army that is eligible to shoot.
Librarius Conclave.effect: Select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to one or more PSYKER models in your unit (excluding units with the Lone Operative ability), and roll six D6, adding 1 to each result if the Telekinesis Discipline is active for your army: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

Librarius Conclave.name: FIERY SHIELD
Librarius Conclave.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Librarius Conclave.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry or Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit from your army that is within 18" of one or more friendly Adeptus Astartes Psyker models, and that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Librarius Conclave.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll, and if the Pyromancy Discipline is active for your army, weapons that target your unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.

Librarius Conclave.name: IRON ARM
Librarius Conclave.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army that is within 18" of one or more Adeptus Astartes Psyker models from your army and has not been selected to Fight this phase.
Librarius Conclave.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit, or add 2 if the Biomancy Discipline is active for your army.

Librarius Conclave.name: PRESCIENT PRECISION
Librarius Conclave.target: One Adeptus Astartes Psyker unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Librarius Conclave.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability, and the [IGNORES COVER] ability as well if the Divination Discipline is active for your army.

Librarius Conclave.name: SENSORY ASSAULT
Librarius Conclave.target: One Adeptus Astartes Psyker unit from your army.
Librarius Conclave.effect: Select one enemy unit that is within 18" of and visible to one PSYKER model in your unit. Until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is pinned. While a unit is pinned, subtract 2 from that unit’s Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it. In addition, if the Telepathy Discipline is active for your army, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

Lion’s Blade Task Force.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Lion’s Blade Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Lion’s Blade Task Force
Lion’s Blade Task Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Lion’s Blade Task Force.name: ILLUMINATING FIRE
Lion’s Blade Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Lion’s Blade Task Force
Lion’s Blade Task Force.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a RAVENWING unit from your army has selected its targets.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.effect: Select one enemy unit within 12" of your unit that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly Deathwing unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

Lion’s Blade Task Force.name: INESCAPABLE WRATH
Lion’s Blade Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Lion’s Blade Task Force
Lion’s Blade Task Force.when: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.target: One Deathwing Infantry or Deathwing Walker unit from your army that is within 6" of one or more enemy units and would be eligible to declare a charge against one or more of those enemy units if it were your Charge phase.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.effect: Your unit now declares a charge that only targets one or more of those enemy units, and you resolve that charge.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.restrictions: Note that even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.

Lion’s Blade Task Force.name: KNIGHTS OF IRON
Lion’s Blade Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Lion’s Blade Task Force
Lion’s Blade Task Force.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.target: One Ravenwing unit from your army.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

Lion’s Blade Task Force.name: OVERPOWERING EXACTION
Lion’s Blade Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Lion’s Blade Task Force
Lion’s Blade Task Force.when: Command phase or the start of the Fight phase.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. When doing so, if your unit has the Deathwing or Ravenwing keyword, subtract 1 from the result.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.

Lion’s Blade Task Force.name: STRENGTH IN UNITY
Lion’s Blade Task Force.group: SPACE MARINES - Lion’s Blade Task Force
Lion’s Blade Task Force.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.effect: If that enemy unit is within Engagement Range of one or more Ravenwing units from your army, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll. If that enemy unit is within Engagement Range of one or more Deathwing units from your army, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of the target, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
Lion’s Blade Task Force.restrictions: A unit cannot be targeted by this and the Armour of Contempt Stratagem in the same phase.

Orbital Assault Force.name: AUTO‑SENSE COORDINATION
Orbital Assault Force.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Orbital Assault Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Orbital Assault Force.effect: Select the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have this ability in a turn in which they disembarked from a Drop Pod or while targeting an enemy unit within 12".

Orbital Assault Force.name: BLIND SCREEN
Orbital Assault Force.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Orbital Assault Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding Titanic units) from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks and one friendly Adeptus Astartes Smoke Vehicle or Drop Pod unit within 9" of it.
Orbital Assault Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your units have the Stealth ability and each time a ranged attack targets one of your units, models in that unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

Orbital Assault Force.name: ONWARD FOR THE EMPEROR
Orbital Assault Force.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Orbital Assault Force.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army that was not set up on the battlefield this turn and one friendly Transport it is able to embark within.
Orbital Assault Force.effect: If your ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is wholly within 6" of that TRANSPORT, it can embark within it.

Orbital Assault Force.name: SHOCK ONSLAUGHT
Orbital Assault Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Orbital Assault Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".

Orbital Assault Force.name: SUPPRESSION STRAFING
Orbital Assault Force.effect: Select one enemy unit visible to and within 18" of your unit. That enemy unit takes a Battle-shock test. When doing so, subtract 1 from that test and, if that test is failed, until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is suppressed. While a unit is suppressed, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Orbital Assault Force.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle round.

Orbital Assault Force.name: TACTICAL DECAPITATION
Orbital Assault Force.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Orbital Assault Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Orbital Assault Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability and each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.

Pilum Strike Team.name: ENHANCED EFFICIENCY
Pilum Strike Team.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Pilum Strike Team.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to make a Normal or Advance move, it can attempt to operate one Hatchway it is within 1” of either at the start or end of that move. If it does, it cannot attempt to operate a Hatchway again this turn.

Pilum Strike Team.name: FIGHTING RETREAT
Pilum Strike Team.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army is selected to Fall Back.
Pilum Strike Team.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit and roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds.

Pilum Strike Team.name: KNIFE WORK
Pilum Strike Team.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Pilum Strike Team.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.

Pilum Strike Team.name: MASTER MARKSMEN
Pilum Strike Team.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Pilum Strike Team.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

Rage-cursed Onslaught.name: A GRIM WARNING
Rage-cursed Onslaught.target: One Blood Angels unit from your army that was just destroyed while it was within range of one or more objective markers you controlled at the end of the previous phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
Rage-cursed Onslaught.effect: Select one of those objective markers. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

Rage-cursed Onslaught.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Rage-cursed Onslaught.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Rage-cursed Onslaught.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Rage-cursed Onslaught.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Rage-cursed Onslaught.name: DEATHLESS DUTY
Rage-cursed Onslaught.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Rage-cursed Onslaught.target: One Death Company unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Rage-cursed Onslaught.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Rage-cursed Onslaught.name: INSENSATE RAMPAGE
Rage-cursed Onslaught.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Rage-cursed Onslaught.target: One Death Company unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Rage-cursed Onslaught.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

Rage-cursed Onslaught.name: LIMB FROM LIMB
Rage-cursed Onslaught.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn.
Rage-cursed Onslaught.effect: Select either the Strength or Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the selected characteristic. You can instead choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst; if it does, it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it), and until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.

Rage-cursed Onslaught.name: RED WRATH
Rage-cursed Onslaught.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army Advances.
Rage-cursed Onslaught.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to either shoot or declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. You can instead choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst; if it does, it becomes Battle-shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it), and until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Reclamation Force.name: CRUSADING CONQUERORS
Reclamation Force.effect: Until the start of the next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit.

Reclamation Force.name: FIGHT TO THE END
Reclamation Force.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Reclamation Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Reclamation Force.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Reclamation Force.name: FURIOUS DEDICATION
Reclamation Force.when: Your Charge phase or the Fight phase.
Reclamation Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not declared a charge or been selected to fight this phase.
Reclamation Force.effect: Until the end of the turn, add 2 to Charge rolls made for your unit and add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
Reclamation Force.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per turn.

Reclamation Force.name: MARCHING EVER ON
Reclamation Force.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back.
Reclamation Force.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase.
Reclamation Force.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6"+1.

Reclamation Force.name: SCIONS OF GUILLIMAN
Reclamation Force.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army ends a Fall Back move.
Reclamation Force.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Reclamation Force.name: ULTRAMARIAN DESTINY
Reclamation Force.effect: Select one objective marker you control that your unit is within range of. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

Saga of the Beastslayer.name: COORDINATED STRIKE
Saga of the Beastslayer.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Beastslayer
Saga of the Beastslayer.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Saga of the Beastslayer.target: One Space Wolves unit from your army that is wholly within 9" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Saga of the Beastslayer.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Saga of the Beastslayer.name: IMPETUOSITY
Saga of the Beastslayer.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Beastslayer
Saga of the Beastslayer.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Saga of the Beastslayer.target: One Wulfen Infantry or Blood Claws unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Saga of the Beastslayer.effect: Until the end of the phase, after that enemy unit has shot, if one or more models in your unit were destroyed as a result of those attacks, your unit can make an Impetuous move. To do so, roll one D6: your unit can be moved a number of inches up to the result, but your unit must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT). When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

Saga of the Beastslayer.name: PINNING FIRE
Saga of the Beastslayer.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Beastslayer
Saga of the Beastslayer.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Saga of the Beastslayer.effect: Until the end of the phase, after your unit has shot, select one enemy CHARACTER, MONSTER, or VEHICLE unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next Shooting phase, that unit is pinned. While a unit is pinned, subtract 2" from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it.

Saga of the Beastslayer.name: SHOCK CAVALRY
Saga of the Beastslayer.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Beastslayer
Saga of the Beastslayer.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
Saga of the Beastslayer.target: One Thunderwolf Cavalry unit from your army that has not been selected to move or declared a charge this phase.
Saga of the Beastslayer.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move through models (excluding TITANIC models) and sections of terrain features that are 4" or less in height. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but unless it is making a Charge move, it cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them.

Saga of the Beastslayer.name: THUNDEROUS PURSUIT
Saga of the Beastslayer.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Beastslayer
Saga of the Beastslayer.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Saga of the Beastslayer.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Saga of the Beastslayer.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6". If your unit has the Space Wolves Infantry or Thunderwolf Cavalry keywords, it can make a Normal move of up to 6" instead.

Saga of the Beastslayer.name: UNBRIDLED FEROCITY
Saga of the Beastslayer.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Beastslayer
Saga of the Beastslayer.target: One Space Wolves unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Saga of the Beastslayer.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

Saga of the Bold.name: ALPHA STRIKE
Saga of the Bold.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Bold
Saga of the Bold.target: One Adeptus Astartes Character unit from your army.
Saga of the Bold.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Saga of the Bold.name: BIRTH OF A SAGA
Saga of the Bold.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Bold
Saga of the Bold.target: One Wolf Guard Headtaker or Wolf Guard Terminator Pack Leader model from your army.
Saga of the Bold.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, your model has the CHARACTER keyword. Designer’s Note: While in effect, your model’s unit is therefore a CHARACTER unit, meaning it can interact with the Heroes All rule, in addition to other rules that interact with CHARACTER units.

Saga of the Bold.name: CHAMPION’S GUIDANCE
Saga of the Bold.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Bold
Saga of the Bold.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Saga of the Bold.target: One Space Wolves Character unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Saga of the Bold.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

Saga of the Bold.name: COUNTERCHARGE
Saga of the Bold.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Bold
Saga of the Bold.when: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.
Saga of the Bold.target: One Adeptus Astartes Character unit from your army that is within 6" of one or more enemy units and would be eligible to declare a charge against one or more of those enemy units if it were your Charge phase.
Saga of the Bold.effect: Your unit now declares a charge that targets only one or more of those enemy units, and you resolve that charge as if it were your Charge phase. Note that even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.

Saga of the Bold.name: HEROIC RESOLVE
Saga of the Bold.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Bold
Saga of the Bold.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Saga of the Bold.target: One Space Wolves Character unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Saga of the Bold.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

Saga of the Bold.name: INSPIRING PRESENCE
Saga of the Bold.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Bold
Saga of the Bold.target: One Adeptus Astartes Character unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Saga of the Bold.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

Saga of the Great Wolf.name: BATTLE INSTINCTS
Saga of the Great Wolf.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Great Wolf
Saga of the Great Wolf.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Saga of the Great Wolf.target: One Space Wolves unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Saga of the Great Wolf.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

Saga of the Great Wolf.name: EYE OF THE PACK
Saga of the Great Wolf.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Great Wolf
Saga of the Great Wolf.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Saga of the Great Wolf.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can add 1 to the Wound roll.

Saga of the Great Wolf.name: FENRISIAN FEROCITY
Saga of the Great Wolf.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Great Wolf
Saga of the Great Wolf.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
Saga of the Great Wolf.target: One Adeptus Astartes Mounted or Adeptus Astartes Walker unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
Saga of the Great Wolf.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move horizontally through models (excluding TITANIC models) and terrain features. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but cannot end a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within Engagement Range of them.

Saga of the Great Wolf.name: GRIMNAR’S COMMAND
Saga of the Great Wolf.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Great Wolf
Saga of the Great Wolf.effect: Select one Hunting Pack from the Master of Wolves Detachment rule. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Hunting Pack is active for your unit instead of any other Hunting Pack that is active, even if you have already selected that Hunting Pack this battle.

Saga of the Great Wolf.name: THE FOE FORESEEN
Saga of the Great Wolf.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Great Wolf
Saga of the Great Wolf.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Saga of the Great Wolf.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Saga of the Great Wolf.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Saga of the Great Wolf.name: UNRELENTING HUNTERS
Saga of the Great Wolf.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Great Wolf
Saga of the Great Wolf.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Saga of the Great Wolf.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit is a Space Wolves unit, until the end of the turn, it is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

Saga of the Hunter.name: BOUNDING ADVANCE
Saga of the Hunter.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Hunter
Saga of the Hunter.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
Saga of the Hunter.target: One Space Wolves Infantry or Space Wolves Beasts unit from your army that has not been selected to move or declared a charge this phase.
Saga of the Hunter.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move through models (excluding Titanic models). When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but unless it is making a Charge move, it cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them.

Saga of the Hunter.name: CHOSEN PREY
Saga of the Hunter.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Hunter
Saga of the Hunter.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Space Wolves unit from your army Falls Back.
Saga of the Hunter.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Saga of the Hunter.name: HUNTERS’ TRAIL
Saga of the Hunter.group: SPACE MARINES - Saga of the Hunter
Saga of the Hunter.target: One Space Wolves unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
